effects.does: Clicking it opens Clara's assistance panel.
effects.affects: nothing until Clara generates or applies content to the event.
effects.check: Click Ask Clara and verify that the Clara panel opens.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the attachment interface so the buyer can add files.
effects.check: Click Add Attachments and verify that an interface for selecting files appears.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the terms-and-conditions editor.
effects.check: Click Add T&Cs and verify that the terms editor opens.

effects.does: Clicking it opens the manage line items section.
effects.affects: the event's line_items record, including added or deleted items.
effects.leadsTo: manage line items drawer or dialog
effects.check: Click Items 0 and verify that the line-item manager opens and shows zero items.

effects.does: The disabled button cannot save the event as a draft.
effects.affects: nothing because no draft is saved.
effects.check: Verify that Save as draft is disabled while no template and line items are present.

effects.does: Clicking it validates the event and, if validation succeeds, publishes it.
effects.affects: the event and its stages, changing them from draft toward the published or active flow.
effects.leadsTo: validation feedback or the published event/project
effects.check: Click Publish with the current incomplete form and verify that publishing is blocked with the applicable validation message.

effects.does: Clicking it selects or opens the lot-level ranking configuration.
effects.affects: the auction's ranking and lot-closing strategy.
effects.leadsTo: auction strategy configuration or stays here with the lot ranking option selected
effects.check: Click Rank on lot and verify that the lot-based ranking setting is selected or its configuration opens.

effects.affects: the event's selected template and the configuration data derived from that template.
effects.check: Click Select Templates and verify that available templates are displayed.

effects.affects: the event's audience_company_uuids and participant records.
effects.check: Click Participants and verify that vendors or participants can be added or managed.

effects.does: The disabled button cannot open or edit savings settings.
effects.affects: nothing because savings cannot currently be changed.
effects.check: Verify that Savings is disabled until a template and at least one product are present.

effects.does: The disabled button cannot open or edit terms and conditions settings.
effects.affects: nothing because the control is unavailable.
effects.check: Verify that Terms & Conditions is disabled while the required template and product prerequisites are missing.

effects.does: The disabled button cannot open or change the event schedule.
effects.affects: nothing because the schedule cannot currently be edited from this control.
effects.check: Verify that the schedule control is disabled before a template and product are added.

effects.does: Clicking the selected Auction tab displays the auction configuration stage.
effects.affects: nothing beyond the currently displayed stage configuration.
effects.check: Click Auction and verify that it remains selected and its configuration is visible.

effects.does: Clicking it navigates away from event creation to the events area.
effects.check: Click Events and verify that the events list or events landing screen opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Entering text sets the project title.
effects.affects: the event group's title and the title used in publish validation and confirmation.
effects.check: Enter a title and verify that the field retains it and the title is used when publishing.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: The disabled vendor search cannot be used to search for or add vendors.
effects.affects: nothing because audience participants cannot currently be changed through this field.
effects.check: Verify that the vendor search is disabled until the required template and line-item prerequisites are met.

cases.title: Save as draft becomes enabled after adding a line item and selecting a template
steps: Click button "Select Templates".
Choose any template from the list.
Click button "Items 0".
Add a line item with a product and quantity.
Observe the state of button "Save as draft".
cases.expected: Button "Save as draft" is now enabled. Tooltip on the button is no longer shown.
cases.setup: Screen is loaded with no line items and no template selected.

cases.title: Publish button shows tooltip when no participants are added
steps: Click button "Publish".
cases.expected: A toast or modal appears with message "Please add participants to proceed!" and publishing is blocked.
cases.setup: Template selected and at least one line item added, but no participants added.

cases.title: Attempt to publish with empty project title shows validation message
steps: Click button "Publish".
cases.expected: A validation toast appears with text "Please fill project title!" and the publish action is aborted.
cases.setup: Leave the title field blank, select a template and add a line item.

cases.title: Changing the selected template prompts confirmation dialog
steps: Click button "Select Templates".
Choose a different template.
cases.expected: A modal appears with message "Changing template will reset data. Are you sure?" and options "Yes" and "Cancel".
cases.setup: A template is already selected and line items are added.
gaps: Reliably choose a different template when the case provides no alternative template name.

cases.title: Publish with auction mode but no valid auction strategy shows error
steps: Click button "Publish".
cases.expected: A toast appears with message "Please select a valid auction strategy" and the project is not published.
cases.setup: Create a quick‑create auction project, select a template and add at least one line item, but leave the auction strategy unset.
gaps: The catalog cannot unset or create an invalid auction strategy; configure_single_stage only accepts valid strategies and defaults to Rank.

cases.title: Disabled "Now - 01:09 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins )" button shows tooltip until schedule is set
steps: Hover over button "Now - 01:09 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins )".
cases.expected: Button remains disabled and a tooltip appears with text "Please select template for <stage title>" or "Please add line items".
cases.setup: Screen loaded with no template selected and no line items.
gaps: The catalog cannot assert an OR condition accepting either the exact stage-specific message "Please select template for <stage title>" or "Please add line items"; it checks the template guidance substring only.

cases.title: Vendor selection stays blocked until a template and line item exist
steps: Hover over Search vendors you want to add.
Verify the tooltip says "Please select template for <stage title>".
Click Select Templates.
Choose a template.
Hover over Search vendors you want to add.
Verify the tooltip says "Please add line items".
Click Items 0.
Add one line item in the manage line items section.
Close the manage line items section.
Verify Search vendors you want to add is enabled.
cases.expected: The vendor selector is disabled first with the applicable exact tooltip, then becomes enabled after a template and at least one line item are present.
cases.setup: Open the quick-create screen with no template and no line items.
gaps: expected message "Please select template for Auction" is neither a known product message nor quoted by the case

cases.title: Save as draft enables after a template and product are added
steps: Verify Save as draft is disabled.
Enter a project title in Enter the title of the project.
Click Select Templates.
Choose a template.
Click Items 0.
Add one product line item.
Close the manage line items section.
cases.expected: Save as draft becomes enabled after a template and at least one product exist.
cases.setup: Use the default Auction stage. Leave the title empty, with no template and no line items.

cases.title: Ask Clara requires project line items
steps: Click Ask Clara.
Wait for the Clara response to load.
cases.expected: The Clara panel opens and generated RFP questions are displayed after the AI requests complete.
cases.setup: Select a template and add at least one project line item.
gaps: Assert that the Clara response contains generated RFP questions after the AI requests complete.

cases.title: Publish opens the confirmation modal with the truncated project title
steps: Enter a project title longer than 45 characters in Enter the title of the project.
Click Publish.
cases.expected: A confirmation modal opens showing the exact text "Publish Event". The project title is truncated to 45 characters, and the confirmation action text is "Publish".
cases.setup: Use a standard Auction that is not routed to the auction team. Select a template, add one line item, and add at least one participant.

cases.title: Disabled scheduling control cannot be changed from the create screen
steps: Verify Now - 02:33 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins ) is disabled.
Try to click Now - 02:33 am, 21st Oct ( 30 Mins ).
cases.expected: The control remains disabled and no schedule editor opens.
cases.setup: Open the quick-create screen with its default schedule displayed.
